local_split: three equal-duration chronological blocks; remove +/-5 seconds around both boundaries; three rotations train/validation/evaluation
nested_budget_selection: hash ranking within training block only, no labels
risk_constraint: both person and vehicle validation point FPR <= budget; both classes required
gate_objective: maximum validation dust recall, then precision, then higher threshold
low_gate: validation dust score 5% quantile capped below high gate
frozen_evaluation: public pilot test and local evaluation block descriptive only, never fit or selection
adaptation_default_features: all 16 pilot features; not chosen from ablation results
extra_normalization_ablation: target/joint B2 at largest budget, conditional intensity fitted training subset only
